results.title: Airlift Northwest | Air Ambulance | UW Medicine
results.snippet: Founded in response to a tragic house fire in Sitka, Alaska, Airlift Northwest became the region’s first hospital-based air ambulance program under the leadership of Dr. Michael Copass at UW Medicine.

results.title: Contact Airlift Northwest | UW Medicine
results.snippet: Contact Airlift Northwest (a UW Medicine affiliate) for more information on our air ambulance services. Request transport at 206.329.2569 or 800.426.2430.

results.title: Air Methods, Airlift Northwest continue relationship - UW Medicine | Newsroom
results.snippet: Air Methods and UW Medicine have been collaborating to serve communities in the region since 2015. Airlift Northwest is dedicated to providing safe, efficient air medical care to critically ill and injured infants, children, and adults.

results.title: Airlift Northwest – UW Alumni Association
results.snippet: UW Medicine’s Airlift Northwest program is proud to offer UWAA members in Washington and Southeast Alaska discounted Airlift Northwest annual membership.

results.title: Airlift Northwest Membership | UW Medicine
results.snippet: Lifesaving air medical transport can be expensive and insurances may not cover all costs. As a member, only your insurance company receives a bill. Airlift Northwest works directly with your insurance company for claims processing. The membership program is secondary to all payers.
